texture_rotation.note: The clouds turn with System II, not the IAU meridian (System III, the interior's): the texture is turned so the Great Red Spot sits at its observed System II longitude (js/scene/Planet.md)
texture_rotation.wSource: System II, W = 43.3° + 870.270° d (the conventional meridian; as in Stellarium's ssystem_major.ini)

feature.name: Great Red Spot
feature.source: System II longitude 216° on 2014-09-08, 349° in 2021 January (Sky & Telescope's transit tool, from JUPOS) and 46° on 2023-10-01 (Stellarium's default), all within 1° of 46° + 21°/yr; good to ~20° within a few years of 2023
